enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner running to stay comfortable through the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the quilt up over the chest. Turn the body onto the left side. Place the left arm under the pillow. Breathe steadily with eyes closed. Turn the body onto the back. Stretch both legs down the mattress. Turn the head on the pillow. Pull the quilt down to the waist. Turn the body onto the right side. Bend the knees slightly. Keep the eyes closed. Reach one hand out and touch the edge of the pillow. Pull the pillow closer under the head. Lie still with the air conditioner running above the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Push the quilt back with both hands. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Reach for the light switch and press it on. Turn on the cold water tap. Cup both hands and splash water onto the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Lift the brush to the mouth and brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap and rinse the mouth. Turn off the tap. Take the towel off the hook and wipe the face. Hang the towel back on the hook. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast: toast, fruit and a cup of tea from the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Pull open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread, a piece of fruit and the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Put two slices of bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Take a plate from the cupboard. Take a cup from the cupboard. Take the toast out of the toaster and put it on the plate. Peel the fruit with the hands. Put the peel into the bin. Sit down at the table. Pick up the toast and bite it. Chew and swallow. Pour hot water into the cup and add a tea bag. Stir the cup with a spoon. Pick up the cup and drink. Eat the fruit. Stand up and carry the plate and cup to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes, packing a water bottle, sunscreen and lunch into the work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work shirt and trousers. Lay them on the bed. Take off the night clothes. Pull on the shirt. Button the shirt front. Pull on the trousers. Put on the socks. Put on the shoes and tie the laces. Walk to the kitchen and take the water bottle and lunch box out of the refrigerator. Walk back to Bedroom 1. Pick up the sunscreen bottle from the dresser. Put the water bottle, the sunscreen and the lunch box into the work bag. Pull the zipper closed. Pick up the bag by the handle. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital on public transport during the hot morning
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the building and along the street to the bus stop. Stand at the stop and look at the phone screen. Hold the phone in the right hand. Step forward as the bus arrives. Board the bus. Tap the transport card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Grip the overhead handrail with the left hand. Shift the work bag onto the shoulder. Step aside as other passengers pass. Press the stop button before the stop. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement to the hospital entrance. Push open the entrance door. Walk to the staff changing area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing patients, running rehabilitation exercises and updating clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Hang the work bag on the hook. Put on the work coat. Pick up the patient list from the desk. Walk to the treatment room. Greet the first patient. Sit down beside the patient. Lift the patient's arm and bend the elbow. Press the shoulder joint with the hands. Write the findings on the assessment sheet. Stand up and guide the patient to the parallel bars. Hold the patient's waist while the patient steps forward. Count the steps aloud. Walk the patient back to the chair. Pick up the resistance band and hand it to the patient. Demonstrate the arm raise. Watch the patient repeat the movement. Take the band back. Walk to the desk and open the computer. Type the clinical notes into the patient record. Save the file. Stand up and call the next patient from the waiting area. Walk to the treatment room with the next patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital, eating packed lunch and rehydrating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff break room. Sit down at the table. Open the work bag. Take out the lunch box and the water bottle. Open the lunch box lid. Pick up the fork and eat the food. Chew and swallow. Unscrew the water bottle cap. Lift the bottle and drink. Screw the cap back on. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Close the lunch box lid. Put the lunch box and the bottle back into the bag. Stand up and walk back to the treatment area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy sessions, guiding patients through mobility and strengthening programs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the gym area of the department. Greet the patient seated on the treatment bed. Help the patient lie down on the bed. Lift the patient's leg and bend the knee. Press the thigh with both hands. Straighten the leg. Ask the patient to push against the hand. Write the result on the chart. Help the patient sit up. Hand the walker to the patient. Walk beside the patient along the corridor. Count the steps. Stop at the chair and help the patient sit down. Walk to the desk and pick up the phone. Answer the call from the ward. Write down the room number on the notepad. Hang up the phone. Walk to the ward with the patient file. Return to the treatment room. Update the exercise plan on the computer. Print the plan sheet. Hand the sheet to the patient.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital on public transport in the afternoon heat
enriched_activities.desc: Take off the work coat and hang it on the hook. Pick up the work bag from the hook. Walk out of the hospital door. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take the phone out of the pocket and check the phone screen. Put the phone back. Step forward and board the bus. Tap the transport card on the reader. Sit down on the empty seat. Place the work bag on the lap. Press the stop button before the stop. Stand up and step off the bus. Walk along the street to the building entrance. Open the door. Walk to the flat door and unlock it. Step inside and close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower to wash off sweat and cool down after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Put the work bag down on the floor. Press the light switch on. Turn on the water heater switch. Pull off the shirt and trousers. Drop the clothes into the laundry basket. Step into the shower area. Turn the shower tap to the cold side. Stand under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the soap and rub it over the arms. Rub the soap over the chest and legs. Rinse the body under the water. Pick up the shampoo bottle and pour shampoo into the hand. Rub it into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn the tap off. Take the towel off the hook. Wipe the body and hair. Wrap the towel around the waist. Turn off the light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Put the vegetables on the counter. Turn on the tap and wash the vegetables. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Press the induction cooker button on. Place the pan on the cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir the vegetables with the spatula. Crack the eggs into the pan. Stir again. Press the cooker button off. Take a plate from the cupboard. Tip the food onto the plate. Sit down at the table. Pick up the chopsticks and eat. Drink water from the cup. Stand up and carry the plate and pan to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with the air conditioner on, watching TV and resting the legs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Press the temperature down button. Put the remote back on the table. Sit down on the sofa. Lift both legs onto the sofa cushion. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Press the channel button to change the channel. Put the remote down on the cushion. Watch the TV screen. Lift the water cup from the table and drink. Put the cup back on the table. Pick up the phone from the pocket and swipe the screen. Put the phone down. Press the volume button on the remote. Lean back against the cushion. Rub the right calf with the hand. Press the leg muscle with the fingers. Stand up and walk to the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review patient notes and read up on physiotherapy techniques
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the study. Press the light switch on. Pull out the chair and sit down. Press the desk lamp switch on. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen to load. Move the mouse and click the patient file folder. Scroll through the patient notes with the mouse wheel. Type notes on the keyboard. Open the browser and search for physiotherapy technique articles. Scroll the web page. Read the article on the screen. Click the bookmark button. Close the browser window. Click the shutdown button. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Press the desk lamp switch off. Press the light switch off and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Press the light switch on. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Take the towel off the hook and wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Pick up the clothes from the laundry basket and load them into the washing machine. Close the washing machine door. Press the washing machine start button. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Going to bed and sleeping with the air conditioner set for the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Press the light switch on. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the bedside table. Press the power button on the remote. Press the temperature down button. Put the remote back on the bedside table. Pull the quilt back. Sit down on the bed. Take off the socks. Take off the clothes and put on the night clothes. Pick up the phone and place it on the bedside table. Press the light switch off. Lie down on the bed. Pull the quilt up over the chest. Turn the body onto the right side. Close the eyes and keep still with the air conditioner running.
